name: STAC VCS Extension
abstract: STAC VCS Extension for describing version control system references.
description: Wraps the STAC VCS extension v0.1.0. VCS metadata can be attached to STAC Catalogs, Collections, Items, Assets and Links. In particular, a Link with rel=vcs can identify the source repository or other version-control resource for an application described with the STAC Application extension.

examples.title: STAC item with an application source repository link
